tasks.task: Identify today's top headline in the Soccer section of ESPN, and summarize the main points of that article.
tasks.answer: Today's top headline in ESPN's Soccer section is: "Man United implode at Chelsea, and, make no mistake, they are in a Premier League relegation battle" (https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50335264/man-united-implode-chelsea-in-premier-league-relegation-battle). Summary of main points: Manchester United are now in a Premier League relegation battle regardless of who manages them. Chelsea's 2-0 win made it four defeats in five games, leaving interim manager Michael Carrick likely to depart, yet the club's leaderless hierarchy chose to keep him on as a lame-duck coach rather than appoint available Premier League-proven options such as Eddie Howe, Antonio Conte, Kieran McKenna, or Julian Nagelsmann. After a 3-0 home loss to Bournemouth left Carrick seemingly on the brink during United's worst start since 1986, the board took a 'collective view to give them a chance to turn it around,' leaving the team to fight for Premier League survival.
